attributes.residual: TWO mechanisms, both named, neither statement-order. (1) COALESCING-PARTNER CHOICE at 0x4a0/0x4a4, 4 words plus 2 displaced. Source is `tmpr = CritterCollidePlayers(c, delta, hits); hits = hits + tmpr; pr = tmpr;`. The target coalesces `tmpr` with the RETURN REGISTER, so it emits `@0x4a0 add r29,r29,r3` then `@0x4a4 addi r28,r3,0`; ours coalesces `tmpr` with `pr`'s callee-saved home instead, so it emits `@0x4a0 addi r29,r3,0` then `@0x4a4 add r28,r28,r29`. Both are valid coalescings of the same two copies and the accumulator/capture register roles swap as a consequence (hits r29 target / r28 ours, pr r28 target / r29 ours, `@0x530 cmpwi r28,0` versus `@0x530 cmpwi r29,0`). Axis 3 proves the statement order between the add and the capture does not select the partner; axis 1 proves declaration order does not select the register. (2) VOLATILE-FPR RENUMBERING over 0x1f8-0x46c, 69 of the 73 renaming rows, pivoting on the long-lived `zero` web (f0 target / f7 ours) - see this record's hypothesis, which is the next lane's step 1. The second displacement pair sits at 0x310/0x314, where the target emits `lfs f6,1232(r30)` then `lfs f5,0(0) @lbl_80346470` and ours emits them transposed; it is INVISIBLE to `fndiff --ops` because both instructions are `lfs`, which is why the census counted 2 mnemonic divergences and regnorm counts 4 unpaired.

hypothesis.statement: CritterTranslate's 76 words split into two mechanisms of very different size, and the SMALLER one is the only thing the census's `2 mnemonic divergences` headline describes. The bulk - 73 of the 76 - is a whole-region VOLATILE-FPR renumbering across 0x1f8-0x46c, and this lane did not probe it. The concrete untried idea for the next lane: the long-lived `zero` web is the pivot. Its defining instruction is `@0x1f8 lfs f0,0(0) @lbl_80346470(EMB_SDA21)` in the target and `@0x1f8 lfs f7,0(0) @lbl_80346470(EMB_SDA21)` in ours; the target parks that whole-region web in f0 and pushes the short-lived scratch triple up to f1/f2/f3, while ours parks it in f7 and starts the scratch at f0. Every other row in the region follows from that one choice (e.g. `@0x354 lfs f0,1180(r30)` target versus `@0x354 lfs f3,1180(r30)` ours). `zero` is currently declared `register f32 zero;` - the 2026-08-26 cap says register hints were byte-invariant, but it never says which hint on which variable, so re-probe the hint ON THIS WEB specifically, and probe splitting `zero` into two webs (one for the delta[1] store at 0x1fc, one for the knockbackVelocity[0] store at 0x2b4) so the long range disappears.
